security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' https: data: asset: http://asset.localhost; media-src 'self' https: data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; frame-src https://www.youtube-nocookie.com https://www.youtube.com

bundle.longDescription: Turbo Reader is a fast, lightweight RSS reader with a Rust core. Feeds are fetched, parsed and sanitised outside the UI, so a malformed article can never take the window down.
